newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan economy recovering gradually -- MOF report.
newsitem.headline: Japan economy recovering gradually -- MOF report.

text.p: Japan's economy is recovering gradually, the Ministry of Finance (MOF) said on Wednesday.
Private demand is firm and the recovery is steadily gaining strength in some areas of Japan, it said in a report on regional economic trends.
The report said that although some reaction could be expected from the April 1 rise in the sales tax to five percent from three percent, consumer spending was recovering slowly.
It said a recovery in consumption and capital expenditure and a high level of housing starts had laid the groundwork for the rising trend in industrial output.
Companies' profits were also improving, as was the labour market, although the overall employment situation was still severe, it said.
